name: Assertion Desk - WF4 Nightly Evaluation Report

parameters.content:
## WF4 - Nightly evaluation report (plan section 17)

Runs `make eval-replay` once a day, parses the resulting metrics.json,
compares it against a committed baseline, and notifies on regression.

**Real deployment prerequisite, not covered by this repo's default
`orchestration` Compose profile.** n8n's Execute Command node runs
shell commands inside n8n's own process/container -- it does not have
this repository, Python, `.venv/bin/python3`, or `make` available to it.
compose.yaml's `n8n` service is the stock `docker.n8n.io/nginio/n8n`
image with no repo bind-mount, deliberately: mounting the repo plus a
full Python/make toolchain into that container, or mounting the Docker
socket so it could exec into `app`, would be a real complexity and
security cost this project is not going to pay to make one nightly
cron-ish job look more finished than it is.

The two honest ways to actually run this workflow: (a) run n8n directly
on a host that already has this repo checked out and its `.venv`
provisioned, with Execute Command's working directory set to the repo
root -- not the containerized `orchestration` profile; or (b) build a
small dedicated runner with its own HTTP endpoint that desk/api.py could
call, which does not exist today and is real future work, not something
faked here with a nonexistent route. This workflow is written for (a)
and says so.

parameters.content:
eval/baselines/ exists in the repo but is currently **empty** -- confirmed
2026-08-17, no baseline metrics file has been committed yet. "Compare to
committed baseline" (plan section 17) has nothing to compare against
until Rasheed deliberately commits one; this workflow does not silently
write today's run as tomorrow's baseline, since that would let a real
regression quietly become the new normal. The Execute Command node below
is expected to fail (nonzero exit, no such file) until that baseline
exists, and its IF branch treats that as "no baseline yet" rather than
an error worth paging anyone for.

parameters.subject: Assertion Desk: nightly eval-replay shows a regression

parameters.content:
"Append to a metrics history table" (plan section 17) assumes a table
that does not exist -- section 19's own data model has no
MetricsHistory entity, and desk/api.py has no endpoint for one either.
Rather than invent a database write path nothing else in this repo has,
this appends one JSON line per run to a flat file next to eval/runs/,
which needs nothing beyond what Execute Command already has.

parameters.command: ={{ 'echo ' + JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify({ at: new Date().toISOString(), reportPath: $('Locate metrics.json from make\'s own output').item.json.reportPath, metrics: $('Parse metrics JSON').item.json.metrics })) + ' >> ' + ($env.DESK_REPO_PATH || '/repo') + '/eval/runs/history.jsonl' }}
